quality_assessment: Page is comprehensive and well-structured with excellent visual aids. Minor issues include missing hyperlink format aliases and a few areas where additional context would be helpful. All cross-references are valid and source code references are accurate.

issues.description: Documentation is missing several hyperlink format aliases that exist in the codebase
issues.fix_suggestion: Add documentation for the following missing hyperlink format aliases: 'grep+' (grep+://), 'kitty' (file:// with line anchor), 'file' (file:// with host), and 'none' (disable hyperlinks)
issues.current_content: Lists: default, vscode, vscode-insiders, vscodium, macvim, textmate, cursor

issues.description: Block-buffered mode is mentioned as default but lacks explanation of when to use it
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief explanation: block buffering is optimal for most use cases as it minimizes system calls and maximizes throughput. Only use line buffering when incremental processing is required.

issues.description: Missing explanation of the --include-zero interaction with JSON output
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify that --include-zero affects which files appear in JSON output. Files with zero matches will have begin/end messages but no match messages when this flag is used.

issues.description: Vimgrep format section is minimal and could benefit from editor integration examples
issues.fix_suggestion: Add examples showing integration with other editors beyond vim, such as Emacs or VSCode's task runner, since the format is editor-agnostic despite the name.
